Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly hypothesizes that the death of Joseph Lyons in 1939 is the event that caused the founder of the Liberal Party to become Prime Minister, failing to distinguish between the United Australia Party era and the Liberal Party era.
